text.jpText:
ふふ……また先生が時間を割いてくださる！
補習という名の！　愛のご指導にッ！！
text.enText:
Hehe… Once again, my teacher is gracing 
me with their time and love in the form of… 
supplementary lessons!!

text.jpText:
これで2か月連続！
それもこれも、私が優等生であるがゆえ！
text.enText:
That makes two months in a row! 
For them to devote so much time 
to me, I must truly be a genius!

text.jpText:
私にかける期待の大きさ、天井……いや！
天井を通り越して大気圏知らずッ！！！
text.enText:
Their expectations for me must reach 
the ceiling. …No! They must reach far 
beyond the atmosphere itself!!

text.jpText:
よーし、今日も張り切りますよー！！
いざっ、バクシンバクシィィン！！！
text.enText:
Therefore, I must give today my all! 
Bakushin, Bakushiiin!!
